description: Utility functions for processing entity usage data, generating reports, and exporting data as CSV or JSON in a dashboard application.

methods.name: getEntityBreakdown
methods.description: Aggregates spend data by entity, summing metrics and returning a sorted array.

methods.name: generateDailyData
methods.description: Creates daily breakdown report data for entities.

methods.name: generateDailyWithModelsData
methods.description: Creates daily breakdown report data for entities with model-specific metrics.

methods.name: generateExportData
methods.description: Selects and generates report data based on export scope.

methods.name: generateMetadata
methods.description: Generates metadata for export files including date range, filters, and totals.

methods.name: handleExportCSV
methods.description: Exports the report data as a CSV file.

methods.name: handleExportJSON
methods.description: Exports the report data as a JSON file with metadata.
